protocols.name: Automated market maker
must_hold: Swaps cannot decrease the configured invariant after fees
Users set minOut/maxIn and a deadline
Donations cannot steal existing LPs
First mint cannot be inflated
common_breaks: Spoof / illiquid tokens moving an internal price curve (Cetus class)

protocols.name: Lending / money market
must_hold: Borrow power uses a fresh, manipulation-resistant price
Accrual happens before every balance change
Liquidations cannot be self-dealt for profit
Bad debt is recognized and cannot brick solvent users
Donation and reserve paths run the same health check as withdraw
common_breaks: Zap / migrate callbacks that accept attacker parameters (Prisma 2024)

protocols.name: Staking / farming / vault
must_hold: Reward checkpoints update before balance changes
Short-lived stake cannot steal prior rewards
Emergency exit cannot trap principal
common_breaks: notifyRewardAmount after deposit in same tx
Permissionless market registration treated as a trusted reward source (Penpie 2024)
Harvest measuring rewards as an untrusted balance delta

protocols.name: Bridge / messaging
must_hold: Each message id is consumed once
Domain (src chain, dest chain, contract) is bound
Zero or stale roots cannot authorize mints
Users have a permissionless completion path

protocols.name: DAO / governor
must_hold: Votes are snapshotted
Execution is delayed
Quorum and threshold cannot be bypassed by flash liquidity

protocols.name: NFT / marketplace
must_hold: safeTransferFrom on mint to contracts
Listings bind token, price, expiry, and nonce
Royalty and fee math cannot overflow to zero

protocols.name: Yield vault / ERC-4626
must_hold: Share conversion resists donation inflation
totalAssets is not a spot-manipulable number
Withdraw paths cannot be bricked by a single token
common_breaks: First depositor attack (still High in Sherlock/C4 2024-2025)
Wrapper vault inheriting underlying ERC-4626 inflation
Async request/claim priced at a later attacker-moved rate

protocols.name: Perps / options / synthetics
must_hold: Mark price is not a single-block spot
Funding and liquidation use the same robust mark
Open interest and OI caps are enforced
